The Pride, led by head coach [[Mo Cassara]], played their home games at the [[Mack Sports Complex]] in [[Hempstead, New York]], as members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]]. The Pride finished in a tie for second in the CAA during the regular season, earning the third seed in the [[2011 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]]. Hofstra won its first game in the tournament, but was eliminated in the semifinals by [[2010–11 Old Dominion Monarchs basketball team|Old Dominion]].{{cite web |title=Hassell's 22 lift Old Dominion past Hofstra, 77-69 |url=https://www.deseret.com/2011/3/6/20177612/hassell-s-22-lift-old-dominion-past-hofstra-77-69 |agency=Associated Press |publisher=[[Deseret News]] |date=March 6, 2011 |access-date=January 25, 2023}} Hofstra failed to qualify for the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], but were invited to the [[2011 College Basketball Invitational]]. The Pride were eliminated in the first round of the CBI in a loss to [[2010–11 Evansville Purple Aces men's basketball team|Evansville]], 77–70.{{cite web |title=Season over as Hofstra men's
